name: Feedback misclassified as product question
description: Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping keywords like 'add', 'support', 'plan'.

name: Feedback misclassified as shipping
description: Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback.

name: Shipping confused with billing
description: Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned.

name: Shipping misclassified as account access
description: Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context.

name: Product question misclassified as billing
description: Model treats plan change or feature availability questions as billing issues when pricing or plan names are mentioned.
